column7: BeginMFAEnrollment, ActivateMFA, DisableMFA, RegenerateMFARecoveryCodes, MFARecoveryCodesRemaining, FinishWebAuthnRegistration, DeleteWebAuthnCredential and FinishWebAuthnReauth folded any GetUser error of the caller into "user not found" (HTTP 400). They now classify it (classifyReadError): a fault answers 503 + Retry-After storage_unavailable with the fixed sentinel text and hands the per-IP slot back; a real not-found stays a refusal; every path fails closed. Core half: ./internal/core TestAuthLane_GetUserReadFault_IsUnavailableNotNotFound; shared mapper: TestWriteWebAuthnErr_StorageReadFaultIs503. VerifyMFAStepUp was already classified on main (#3900). The auth-lane fold exception file is gone (TestNoStorageReadErrorFoldedIntoNotFound has no exception left for this lane).
